data.comment:
# Comfy AIrt MAchIne

Upload any image to generate a unique, looping AI video. The workflow uses an LLM to create five prompts, produces images and video clips, and stitches them into a final seamless loop. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs a COMFY_API_KEY.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/templates_mjm_airt_machIne.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.custom_prompt:
write 5 prompts based on this image, I will use these in a text 2 image model. The prompts should be different, be creative. Only use the image as inspiration.

I want only the prompts and nothing else. Each prompt on its own line.

No empty lines in-between the prompts:
Prompt 1
Prompt 2
Prompt 3
Prompt 4
Prompt 5

data.text: 色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走
